faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers to the questions people ask us before they start. Prices and lead times are the ones shown on each service.

items.a: Aevia is the trading name of Aevia WS, a French sole proprietorship founded by Valentin Milliand, a full-stack developer, registered with the Bourg-en-Bresse trade register (SIREN 852 546 225). It has no connection with the Aevia company of the Eiffage group, which works in energy and infrastructure.

items.q: How much does a website with Aevia Launch cost?
items.a: Between €399 and €1,499, paid once, depending on the plan: Landing (€399), Essentiel (€599), Pro (€899) or Premium (€1,499). Hosting and maintenance then cost €20 a month, free for 3 months with Pro and 6 months with Premium, and can be cancelled at any time. If you don't have a domain name yet, expect about €10 to €15 a year.

items.q: How quickly is my website online?
items.a: Within 2 business hours for the Landing and Essentiel plans, within 24 to 48 hours for Pro, and within 5 to 7 days for a custom Premium project (article 4 of the Aevia Launch terms of sale). The clock starts once payment and all your information have been received.

items.q: How much does the AI customer service (Aevia Inbox) cost?
items.a: From €79 to €999 a month depending on your volume, across five plans: Starter, Growth, Pro, Business and Scale. The price is the same for messages only, voice only or both: only the included quota changes. A one-time €100 setup fee covers connecting your channels and configuring the agent. No commitment, 14-day money-back guarantee. Outside the euro zone, the same amount is billed in US dollars.

items.q: Which channels does the AI answer my customers on?
items.a: Phone, WhatsApp, Instagram, email and your website chat, with the full conversation history in one place. It replies within seconds, day and night, and alerts you when a request is serious.

items.q: Is the security audit really free?
items.a: Yes. You enter your website address and your email, with no account to create and nothing to install: in about a minute you get a score out of 100 and the list of fixes, in order of importance. If you want us to apply them, each fix has a fixed price, from €99 (enabling HSTS) to €1,490–2,490 (full hardening pack), with no subscription.

items.q: Do I need all three services?
items.a: No. Each one works on its own: start with the one you are missing, and add the others later if you need them.
